title: GraphRAGProv: GraphRAG Meets How-Provenance
abstract: arXiv:2610.37237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GraphRAG systems often use knowledge graphs to retrieve relevant context for an LLM that produces the final answer. That makes answers more inscrutable and therefore less appealing for domains where transparency is paramount. We present GraphRAGProv, an architecture that executes SPARQL queries over source-grounded RDF graphs to compute answers and their how-provenance polynomials. These polynomials record which statement occurrences were used and how they were combined. Because each occurrence is linked to its source text, users can follow these links to check whether the extracted statements reflect the text and whether the query combines them to answer the question. Querying thereby becomes a way to inspect and evaluate the text-to-graph transformation. Our interactive demo examines 400 cases from two multi-hop QA benchmarks, revealing extraction and query errors even when the final answer is correct.

translated_title: GraphRAGProv：当 GraphRAG 遇上如何溯源
translated_abstract: GraphRAG 系统通常使用知识图谱为大语言模型（LLM）检索相关上下文，再由 LLM 生成最终答案。这使得答案更加难以解读，因此在透明度至关重要的领域吸引力较低。我们提出了 GraphRAGProv，这是一种在基于源文本的 RDF 图上执行 SPARQL 查询的架构，能够计算答案及其 how-provenance（如何溯源）多项式。这些多项式记录了使用了哪些语句实例以及它们是如何被组合的。由于每个语句实例都与源文本相关联，用户可以沿着这些链接检查提取的语句是否忠实于文本，以及查询是否将这些语句正确组合以回答问题。由此，查询本身成为检查和评估文本到图谱转换质量的一种方式。我们的交互式演示考察了来自两个多跳问答基准的 400 个案例，即使在最终答案正确的情况下，也能揭示出抽取和查询中的错误。
tldr: GraphRAGProv 通过在源文本支撑的 RDF 图上执行 SPARQL 查询并计算答案的 how-provenance 多项式，使 GraphRAG 的答案可追溯、可验证，从而能够暴露文本到图谱转换中隐藏的抽取与查询错误。
en_tdlr: GraphRAGProv executes SPARQL queries over source-grounded RDF graphs to compute answers with how-provenance polynomials, making GraphRAG answers traceable and revealing extraction and query errors even when the final answer is correct.
